newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Biora expects U.S., Swedish listing early Feb.
newsitem.headline: Biora expects U.S., Swedish listing early Feb.

text.p: Swedish biotechnology company Biora AB said on Thursday it expected to be listed in Stockholm and New York in early February following a proposed public global offering of 6.5 million shares.

Biora said it had filed a registration statement with the U.S. securities and Exchange Commission in relation to listing American Depository shares (ADS), each with the right to receive two ordinary shares, on Nasdaq.
Applications have been made to list ordinary shares on the Stockholm Stock Exchange's O-list.
The offering, with Morgan Stanley & Co as global coordinator, is expected to raise about $50 million.
The indicated price range for the offering has been set between 50.50-57.50 crowns per ordinary share and $14.50-16.50 for ADS, Biora said in a statement.
Trading on Nasdaq is expected to start in the week of February 3 and in Stockholm in the week of February 10.
After the offering, the public will hold about 31.4 percent of Biora's share capital while the largest shareholder, Euroventures Nordica, will retain 42.3 percent.

Biora, based in Malmo, southern Sweden, develops, manufactures and sells products for the treatment of periodontal disease and for use in oral surgery. Its principle product, Emdogain, is used to treat defects caused by periodontal disease.

The company has already said income from the new issue will be used to establish a sales organisation in the U.S., to strengthen the European marketing organisation, to develop new applications and treatment methods as well as increase research and development resources.
